{{Quote|Something's wrong. I know it. We're ahead of schedule here. Let me go to the Carreras system.''"<br />"''No. You've been assigned to oversee the Ithorian link in the array, and that's what you'll do. Master Val can more than take care of himself.|Jao Assam and [[Marasiah Fel]]|<ref name="Legacy 2013 2" />}}
In [[138 ABY]], the [[Ithori system/Legends|Ithori system]] was the site of a '''secondary communications array outpost''' that was part of the galactic-wide [[G51 communications array]] network. The [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] was placed in charge of supervising the finishing stages of the Ithorian outpost. Under Jao's leadership, work progressed ahead of schedule. After receiving no communications from the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]], Jao decided to visit the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to ascertain the whereabouts of Master [[Yalta Val]].
